context.discovery.invalid_call.text:

context.discovery.unavailable_target.text:
Nothing was executed. This target is unavailable through CallTool. Use ToolSearch to find the current exact target; call directly declared tools directly.

context.discovery.undiscovered.text:

CallTool input: {"tool":"<exact-discovered-target>","arguments":{...}}

context.discovery.invalid_json.text:

CallTool input: {"tool":"<exact-discovered-target>","arguments":{...}}

context.discovery.invalid_object.text:
Nothing was executed. Put the target input object in arguments; an array, null or a primitive cannot be used.
CallTool input: {"tool":"<exact-discovered-target>","arguments":{...}}

context.discovery.missing_id.text: ToolSearch requires a tracked call ID.

context.discovery.query_limit.text: ToolSearch queries are limited to 4096 characters. Use a shorter purpose or an exact tool name.

context.discovery.invalid_search.text: Provide a nonempty query, an optional server, and max_results between 1 and 10.

context.discovery.result_budget.text: ToolSearch result budget is too small.

context.discovery.rejected_result.text: ToolSearch output was changed, truncated or exceeded its result budget. No new definitions were loaded. Retry the search.

context.discovery.no_services.text: No services currently require discovery. Previously discovered tools must still satisfy the current tool configuration.

context.discovery.interrupted.text: ToolSearch was interrupted before its result was accepted. No new definitions were loaded; search again.

context.discovery.search_description.text: Discover targets to execute through native CallTool and read their complete arguments_schema. Search by purpose or use select:<full tool name> to display an exact target again.

context.discovery.call_description.text:
Execute a target discovered through ToolSearch. Use the native CallTool tool, not assistant text. Put the exact discovered target name in tool and its input object in arguments.

ToolSearch discovers targets; it does not add native tools.
Example CallTool input: {"tool":"mcp__example__lookup","arguments":{"id":"42"}}
Do not stringify arguments. Do not print tool-call syntax as your answer. A call has executed only after you receive its execution result.

context.discovery.conflicting_keys.text:

context.discovery.decode_limit.text:
